items.text: **Mistral Large 4** (#64534) runs on MRV2 with:
sparse MLA plus the DSA indexer, and cross-layer KV sharing;
DSpark, DCP/PCP, NIXL P/D and HiSparse.
**Other new models:**: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash (#64111), plus P/D across different prefill and decode TP (#64475).
**Other new models:**: Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe with MTP and DFlash2 (#64282, #64944).
**DeepSeek-V4 / V4.1**: Prefill gathers compressed KV once per KV-source group: 38 → 4 gathers per step (#59131).
**DeepSeek-V4 / V4.1**: Decoder replay graphs share the model graph pool: prefill graph memory 15.52 → 9.88 GiB per rank on GB200 (#63155).
**DeepSeek-V4 / V4.1**: `fused_inv_rope_fp8_quant` 3.5× faster, prefill 6% faster (#63540).
**DeepSeek-V4 / V4.1**: DSpark/MTP memory savings of about 512 MiB per GPU (#63996).
**DeepSeek-V4 / V4.1**: Engram host tables shared across DP ranks (#62359).
**DeepSeek-V4 / V4.1**: DeepGEMM sparse MQA logits on the FP8 indexer cache (#62011).
**DeepSeek-V4 / V4.1**: Packed multi-image vision encoding, 1.6–2.6× (#65030).
**DeepSeek-V4 / V4.1**: LoRA on the language model, compressor and `wo_a` layers (#57245, #64880).
**DeepSeek-V4 / V4.1**: DSpark with PCP (#61994); PCP with PP or DP (#63098).
**DeepSeek-V4 / V4.1**: Fixes: sparse prefill in FULL CUDA graphs (#59986), prefill memory budgeting (#63047), MTP embedding under PP (#65816), DeepSeek-V3.2 PP (#59961).
GLM-5.3-Flash: DeepGEMM FP8 MegaMoE (#60895), adaptive verification (#60229), row-strided QKV into FlashKDA (#61614).
GLM-5.3 FP8 MoE sorted-A TMA on H200, 6.0–7.6% E2E throughput (#64760).
**GLM**: FP8 KV cache for DSpark and DFlash drafts (#63841, #64612, #65553).
**GLM**: FP32 indexer MQA logits restored for GLM-5/GLM-5.3/HY-V4, with new `--attention-config.indexer_logits_dtype` (#64580).
**GLM**: Fused KDA convs fix stale weights after RL refit (#60991).
**Muse Spark**: Opt-in Muse Spark Open specialized decode on GB300 (#64077).
**Muse Spark**: One RoPE cache shared across layers: 11.5 GiB per GPU saved, 14.5% more KV cache on 8×B200 (#65206).
**Muse Spark**: GEMM and communication+norm fusions (#65438, #64638); hybrid DeepGEMM MegaMoE / TRT-LLM for NVFP4 (#64525).
**Muse Spark**: CUDA routing kernel (#64553), MegaMoE JIT warmup (#63920), DSpark draft loading fix (#65125).
**MiniMax-M3 / M3.1**: Sequence parallelism and GEMM-RS for TP + MegaMoE, 14–20% lower P50 TTFT (#64659), also with PP (#65537).
**MiniMax-M3 / M3.1**: Fused norm + MXFP8 quant, 1.39–1.60× (#64852).
**MiniMax-M3 / M3.1**: Triton query-tiled sparse prefill on Hopper (#57420); SM90 split-K indexer (#64037).
**MiniMax-M3 / M3.1**: No host sync in prefill metadata (#65883); NVFP4 MegaMoE warmup (#66227); fmha_sm100 indexer updates (#66228).
**MiniMax-M3 / M3.1**: Fixes: M3.1 prefill workspace (#64856), sequence parallelism (#65496), encoder CUDA graphs (#65226).
**Kimi**: Opt-in `--attention-backend KIMI_K3_KV_BALANCED_MLA` for agentic workloads on Blackwell (#63638).
Kimi-K3 MegaMoE symmetric buffer 10.73 → 2.50 GiB per GPU at TP8 EP (#63541).
**Kimi**: FlashInfer fused FP8 chunked-context K/V pack (#61527).
**Kimi**: Fixes: KDA prefill OOM (#63989), NaNs via FlashKDA/FlashMLA pins (#64759), sleep mode (#64583, #66273).
Kimi K3.1 groundwork landed (#66030, #66028), but **K3.1 is not servable in this release**.
Qwen3.5: breakable CUDA graphs instead of torch.compile (#51012); fused norm/gate + quant (#64509) and AR + norm + quant (#64723); GDN `in_proj` overlap (#64425, #64999).
**Qwen**: GDN prefill state gather/scatter fused for Qwen3-Next/Qwen3.5 and Kimi KDA, 1.16–1.50× (#66064).

Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: PLE disk offload via `--engram-config '{"disk_offload": true}'` (27 GiB less on DGX Spark, #59958), PP (#60234), shared QSA top-k buffer (#65619), loading fixes (#62318, #65812, #64820, #60490).
**Qwen**: Fixes: long-context int32 overflow (#63761), multi-layer MTP (#62111).
**Other models**: Step5 MegaMoE with PP (#65504) and KV block sizing (#65153).
**Other models**: Gemma 4: multimodal encoder DP (#60314), PP (#65989), FA4 FP8 MMA on SM90 (#60372).
**Other models**: Moved to the Transformers modeling backend: OLMoE (#63384), Gemma v1 and StableLM (#66393), Aria (#59767; temporarily about 11% less KV cache and 25% lower image throughput).
**Other models**: Matryoshka dimensions for EmbeddingGemma 2 (#64885, #60978); RADIO C-RADIO v2/v3/v4 (#58468).
**Other models**: Qwen3-ASR on the upstream Transformers config; no `--hf-overrides` needed for the ForceAligner (#66097, #63274).
**Other models**: Fixes: GPT-OSS MXFP4 LoRA (#65825), PLaMo3 GPTQ (#62836), Ling3 (#65088), DomynEdge (#66819).
**Multimodal**: Encoder CUDA graphs for Pixtral/Mistral3 (#56277), shared capture buffers (#65084), one replay per batch up to `encoder_cudagraph_max_token_budget` (#65227).
**Multimodal**: On-device input normalization for Nemotron VL (#57924), Gemma 3 (#64487), Gemma 4 (#65577).
**Multimodal**: `--mm-encoder-tp-mode data` for MiMo-V2.6 (#64179).

**Multimodal**: Fixes: FlashInfer ViT attention on GLM-4.1V/GLM-OCR/GLM-5.3-Flash (#65778), Qwen3-Omni and Qwen2.5-Omni video budgets (#66017, #66190), dots_ocr with TP (#64543), embedding-only startup (#65689), media cache eviction (#65363).
**Extensible KV cache**: On by default on CUDA and ROCm (#56492).
**Extensible KV cache**: Headroom for measured allocator fragmentation, validated on Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FP8 at TP8+EP on 8×H200 (#67296).

**Extensible KV cache**: Fixes: sizing and startup OOMs (#67485, #66523, #66731, #66197, #65554), connectors that failed to start (#65225), up to 84% undersized caches on DGX Spark (#65413), `--max-model-len auto` (#65463).
**Extensible KV cache**: Startup warning when an explicit `gpu_memory_utilization` withholds memory from it (#66704); docs on when to set it (#67071).
**Model Runner V2**: The only runner after MRV1's removal (#63373); DBO with spec decode and DCP (#61464).
**Model Runner V2**: Separate prefill (token) and decode (request) CUDA graph capture sizes (#63406).
**Model Runner V2**: Staged writes copied straight into UVA (#63633); idle sampler writes skipped, about 10–11% faster small-batch decode (#62748).
**Model Runner V2**: Sampler warmed up after graph capture to stop memory growth under load (#62560).
**Model Runner V2**: Lower peak memory for chunked prompt logprobs (#64841, #64914); Triton ReplaySSM (#65033).
**Model Runner V2**: NVIDIA Confidential Computing decode fixes (#59981).
**Speculative decoding**: Suffix decoding (#60339) and custom speculators (#63205) on MRV2; draft-model CUDA graphs (#60989).
**Speculative decoding**: XPress with adaptive verification (#65175); adaptive verification draft budgets on a Triton kernel (#63421).
**Speculative decoding**: Batch-sharded draft logits (#63554); DSpark sequential blocks (#63886).
**Speculative decoding**: DSpark sliding-window MLA draft layers (#63795) under DCP (#63796); fused Markov sampling, 42–50% less sampling time (#64476); `draft_lm_head_quantization` (#64368).
**Speculative decoding**: Draft KV cache dtype aligned with the target (#65198).
**Speculative decoding**: Trace replay with ngram/EAGLE3/MTP, 1.47–2.03× (#63275); 3× faster resample kernel (#65100).

**Speculative decoding**: Fixes: DFlash acceptance of 0 with FULL CUDA graphs (#64059), a resample race (#66048), acceptance-estimator cancellation (#65229), standalone draft prefill under FULL graphs (#65804), grammar-invalid drafts (#61557).
**Scheduler and engine overhead**: Prompt token ids kept as int32 buffers: 40× less per-request CPU on a 128K prompt (#62702).
**Scheduler and engine overhead**: Per-request id lists kept out of the cyclic GC (#65300); 45–50% less KV block allocation CPU (#65831).
**Scheduler and engine overhead**: New requests and aborts handled while waiting for model output (#65466), with a cheaper wait loop (#65773).
**Scheduler and engine overhead**: Opt-in cache-aware admission via `--cache-aware-admission-window` (#54625).
**Scheduler and engine overhead**: `--max-num-inflight-kv-loads` starts async KV loads while the batch is full (#65319), with cached reservations: 47.2 → 5.4 ms per schedule (#65285).
**Scheduler and engine overhead**: A multimodal item is no longer split by a prefix hit (#65271).
**Startup and compile**: No openai/fastapi imports in EngineCore and workers (#65423, #65589).
**Startup and compile**: CUDA graph memory profile skipped when its estimate is disabled (#64622).
**Startup and compile**: Device-neutral compile cache via `VLLM_COMPILE_ON_ONE_RANK`, on by default (#63247); all graph-affecting config fields hashed into compile cache keys (#65652).
**Startup and compile**: `--shuffle-safetensors-files` for large EP startups (#42837).
**Startup and compile**: `BasevLLMParameter`'s Python `__torch_function__` dropped: GLM-5.2-FP8 TTFT −6.1% on GB300 (#63785).
**Lifecycle**: Process checkpoint/restore over HTTP (#62570); opt-in multi-worker CUDA checkpoint sleep (#64186).
**Lifecycle**: Best-effort NUMA binding by default; `--no-numa-bind` to disable (#61258).
**Lifecycle**: Sleep mode with exact-size pinned backups, up to about 578 GiB less host memory per node on Mistral Large 4 TP8 (#64630); level 2 discards only parameters (#66010, #66165, #59994).

**Lifecycle**: Fast Start weight-cache restarts for online FP8/MXFP8, ModelOpt CUTLASS FP8/NVFP4/block-FP8 and AWQ/GPTQ Marlin (#63672, #63754, #64119, #64182), with pluggable shared warmup-cache stores (#65168).
**Lifecycle**: `WatermarkConfig.enforce` (#62966).
**RL and weight loading**: `VLLM_RELOAD_MODE=direct` writes checkpoint tensors straight into the live model (#64336, #64352, #65281).
**RL and weight loading**: Every load and update finishes through `finalize_model_weights` (#65914, #64357, #64692, #57678).
**RL and weight loading**: Load plans for weight-transfer engines (#65235); per-update NCCL source ranks for PP trainers (#62557).
**RL and weight loading**: Sparse weight patches validated in one pass, 40–48% shorter pause (#66021).
**RL and weight loading**: Offloaded KV tier survives pause/sleep (#57810); partial stacked weights rejected (#63752).
**LoRA**: MoE-LoRA shrink/expand kernels up to 64 tokens (#64653); embedding LoRA scaled by `embed_scale` (#62470).
**LoRA**: Rejected: adapters on unwrapped modules (#63489), non-linear expert placement with EP (#62797).
**LoRA**: Fixes: reloads with requests in flight (#64616), KV-sharing fast prefill (#61162), SEQ_CLS heads (#63286), fused MoE expand rounding (#63894), Mamba-1 (#64681).
**LoRA**: **Batch invariance:** LFM2 ShortConv (#62367), FlashInfer FP8 bmm and W4A16 NVFP4 (#62192), GPTQ (#60479), FA sliding window (#65627), `aten::mm` out_dtype overloads (#60047).
**Expert parallelism and fault tolerance**: DP+EP scale-down via `POST /v1/fault_tolerance/apply` (#46370); MoRI EPv2 (#61361).
**Expert parallelism and fault tolerance**: Opt-in `symm_mem` EPLB weight-migration backend (#62009).
**Expert parallelism and fault tolerance**: `--enable-ep-weight-filter` with EPLB: DeepSeek-R1 NVFP4 DEP8 reads 105 GiB per rank instead of 385 GiB (#64187).
**Expert parallelism and fault tolerance**: `num_redundant_experts` defaults to the minimum valid value (#30614).
**Expert parallelism and fault tolerance**: Skipped combine staging copy in `flashinfer_nvlink_one_sided` (#65498); DeepEP V2 padded rows (#54109).
**Context parallelism and sparse attention**: Token-sharded sparse-MLA prefill under TP (#63956); DCP on the FlashMLA sparse bf16 KV path (#61609).
**Context parallelism and sparse attention**: MLA decode up-projected before the A2A merge with `--dcp-comm-backend a2a` (#64994); faster DCP sparse-indexer top-k (#65178, #64129).
**Context parallelism and sparse attention**: Cross-layer KV cache sharing for MLA layers (#64095).
**Context parallelism and sparse attention**: Fixes: PP rank derivation under PCP (#65539), FlashInfer MLA DCP decode (#59392).

**KV connectors**: NIXL: push mode via `transfer_mode` (#64230); `ucx_backend_params` (rocm_ipc on MI355X: 3.4 → 483.7 Gbps, #62905); 38% fewer hybrid SSM transfer bytes (#62317); block pairing across different P/D block sizes (#59746), with mismatched push handshakes rejected (#59747); same-host NVLink with the extensible KV cache (#65137).

**KV connectors**: Mooncake: selective leases (#63420), automatic `cache_prefix` (#65160), per-GPU RDMA devices (#65076), heterogeneous-TP hybrid sharing (#54307), sleep mode (#59934), lease renewal (#64193).
**KV connectors**: Lookahead block hashes in NIXL, Mooncake and offloading connectors (#64096); UMBP standalone mode (#61795, #61793).
**KV connectors**: Out-of-tree and LMCache MP connectors with the extensible KV cache (#66605, #66674).
**KV offload**: SimpleCPUOffload with one host buffer per rank and opt-in HugeTLB pages (#60130); no zero-filled pool (#64345).
**KV offload**: KVCR v0.2.0 (#64224, #63889); async lookups published per request group (#57474); secondary tiers rejected on multi-node engines (#62930).
**HiSparse**: Uses the extensible KV cache by default: 16% more GPU+host KV capacity (#65214).
**HiSparse**: Fused slot invalidation, up to 1.8% lower TPOT on GLM-5.3-NVFP4 (#60103); fewer hash probes (#61263); speculative-group prefetch (#63801).
**HiSparse**: Platform backend for hardware plugins (#62592); scheduler deadlock fix (#62979).
**EPD and distributed**: Metadata-only image and video inputs for GLM-5.3-Flash and DeepSeek-V4.1 (#64071, #62802).
**EPD and distributed**: Bitwise-identical 1-stage and 2-stage custom all-reduce (#57042); FlashInfer all-reduce gated on 16-byte rows (#63123).
**EPD and distributed**: Cross-node MNNVL groups kept off CUDA IPC all-reduce (#55835).
**NVIDIA**: Step5 NVFP4 TRTLLM-Gen MoE (#65152).

**NVIDIA**: DeepSeek-V4.1: latency_specialized decode extended, 5.9–17% faster decode step on GB300 (#63921); swap-AB CuTe DSL decode attention for TP2/TP4, 1.4–2.15× (#62633); opt-in fused DSpark Markov sampling, 1.6–3.9× (#64442).
**NVIDIA**: Sparse-indexer top-k reads BF16 logits directly (#62172, #64138); single-launch fused prefill top-k (#60618).
**NVIDIA**: GLM-5.3 TMA MoE projections on H200 and SM100 (#63820, #65746); SM90 native small-head sparse FlashMLA, +10% on GLM-5.3-Flash TP4 (#64510).
**NVIDIA**: CuTe DSL BF16x3 router GEMM for fp32 routers on Hopper (#61903); fused GDN MTP decode for DSpark K=8, +18% on B300 (#65874).
**NVIDIA**: GLM-5.3-Flash on 2× DGX Spark, 15% lower TPOT (#62956); faster weight loading on integrated GPUs (#58868).
**NVIDIA**: Rubin locality-domain NVFP4 MoE (#61685); Jetson Thor (SM110) fixes (#62133, #65050, #62275).
**AMD ROCm**: MonoKernel decode for Muse Spark Open DSpark verify (#63440), DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash at TP8 (#64101) and the MiniMax-M3.1 DSpark drafter, +10% P90 interactivity (#65386).
**AMD ROCm**: Kimi-K3 specialized decode (#61435), AITER-tuned prefill GEMMs: mean TTFT 5.35 → 4.05 s (#63730), opt-in FlyDSL FP8 MLA prefill (#59124).
**AMD ROCm**: DeepSeek-V4-Pro P/D over MoRIIO (#48989); Step-5-Preview (#61837) and Reflection Beam 1.0 (#62057) on ROCm.

**AMD ROCm**: RDNA: TRITON_ATTN by default (#60418), AITER Triton kernels on RDNA3 (#52970), HIP GDN prefill backend for gfx1151 (#56307), opt-in W4A16 dense prefill cache: TTFT −22 to −26% on Strix Halo (#60710).
**AMD ROCm**: Fixes: Kimi-K2.6 int4 prefill regression on Triton 3.8 (#62565), MI355 extensible KV cache OOMs (#65418).
**Intel XPU**: PyTorch 2.15 (#63977) and vllm_xpu_kernels 0.1.17 with new MoE/MLA interfaces (#60609).
**Intel XPU**: Per-token dynamic FP8 activations (#61362); faster batched Triton MoE (#51605); MRoPE kernel (#59938); GDN metadata reuse (#64479); DeepSeek-V4 adaptive verification (#62309).
**CPU**: MRV2 on CPU backends without Triton: Arm, IBM Z, PowerPC, RISC-V (#61995).
**CPU**: zentorch 2.14.0.2 (#65669) and Laguna MoE on Zen (#63711).
**CPU**: Faster GDN spec-decode updates (#64829); Gemma 4 MoE gelu_tanh (#61593); bidirectional encoder-only attention (#63738).
**CPU**: **Other:** out-of-tree layer overrides via `vllm.model_executor.hw_agnostic.resolve` (#60218); shared routed-expert row restorers (#64689); Ascend Triton fix (#64013).
New `--quantization lut_b_moe`: about 3.14-bit MoE experts with MXFP8 activations, native on Rubin (#62759).
`w4afp8` checkpoints on the W4A8 FP8 MoE path (#64410).
Block Hadamard input rotation with online `mxfp4_hadamard32` and Quark online-rotation checkpoints (#62750).
CSF-compressed NVFP4 block scales in ModelOpt (#64312); activation quant overrides for online MXFP4 (#51808).
DeepSeek-V4.1 MXFP8 linears on cuBLASLt (#64815); 3× faster MXFP4 activation quant (#63101); faster FP8 quant on SM100+ (#61641).
QuIP NVFP4 on Humming (#65230).
Fixes: NVFP4 NaN logits (#63382, #61755), Humming FP8 (#60163, #56606), hadacore (#63514).
**New endpoints and options**: `/checkpoint/prepare`, `/checkpoint/status`, `/checkpoint/restore` (#62570).
**New endpoints and options**: `thinking_token_budget` on `/v1/responses` (#63896); `/v1/completions` in `vllm run-batch` (#64097).
**New endpoints and options**: Streaming derender on `/inference/v1/generate` (#63103).
**New endpoints and options**: Anthropic Messages API: `min_tokens` (#65459) and `thinking.type=between_tools` (#65954).
**New endpoints and options**: `vllm:request_render_duration_seconds` histogram (#60213).
**Tool calling and reasoning**: New `granite_toolcall_parser` for Granite 4.2 (#65216); llama3_json moved to the ParserEngine (#63569).
**Tool calling and reasoning**: Incremental streaming for Kimi K3 (#62203), `tool_choice="required"` (#60882), DeepSeek V4/V3.2 (#58780), GLM-4.7 (#64535), Qwen3 (#64675).
**Tool calling and reasoning**: Fixes: DeepSeek V4.1 (#62517, #64971, #62729, #62647), GLM-4.7 (#64615), Step3 (#65274), FunctionGemma (#63992), union/enum string parameters (#64518).
**Behavior**: Corrupt or oversized images and disabled local media return 400 instead of 500 (#63433, #60308, #64032).
**Behavior**: Responses accepts incomplete assistant/reasoning history, e.g. from Codex (#35508).
**Behavior**: Multi-template processors use the default template (#63606); an empty `tools` array is accepted like OpenAI (#65547).
**Behavior**: The first streamed usage reports cached prompt tokens (#65036); plain completion stream frames render about 9× faster (#52875).
**Rust frontend**: Stateless Responses API (#63902) with namespace tools (#65853); `n > 1` (#65625); `--skip-tokenizer-init` (#64697).
**Rust frontend**: Hybrid and external DP load balancing (#64451, #64450); native GLM-5.3 chat rendering (#62424).
**Rust frontend**: Prompt block hashing off the engine's GIL (#63842); `--reasoning-effort-map` (#62312).
**Rust frontend**: `--enable-log-outputs`, `--max-log-len`, `--root-path`, `--log-error-stack` (#63769, #64223, #64222, #65001).
**Rust frontend**: More request, response and metric parity with Python (#65293, #65294, #65623, #65624, #64218, #64526, #63964, #65636).
**Security**: ReDoS in the validation-error sanitizer fixed (#52120).
**Security**: FunAudioChat audio bounded to the profiled duration (#57411).
**Security**: `/v1/systemone` honors `--trust-request-chat-template` (#64503).
**Security**: Raised floors for filelock, OpenTelemetry, graphql-core and others (#63574).
**Dependencies**: PyTorch stays at 2.14.0. FlashInfer 0.7.3 (#65930).
**Dependencies**: DeepEP 2.1 (#59844); DeepGEMM pin updates (#64411, #64580, #65494); FlashMLA and FlashKDA pins (#61971, #64759).
**Dependencies**: NIXL 1.5.2 (#64579, #64585); mooncake-transfer-engine 0.3.14 (#65576); Run:ai Model Streamer 0.17.1 (#63174); `fastokens >= 0.3.5` for `VLLM_USE_FASTOKENS` (#65679).
**Dependencies**: ROCm: AITER v0.1.27 → v0.1.28.post1 (#63774, #65937). XPU: PyTorch 2.15 (#63977), triton-xpu 3.9.0 (#65047), vllm_xpu_kernels 0.1.17 (#60609). CPU: zentorch 2.14.0.2 (#65669).
**Build**: x86_64 CUDA wheel about 82 MB (about 25%) smaller, kernels unchanged (#65518).
**Build**: Default CUDA image installs the AWS EFA userspace; the `-efa` image now only adds DeepEP for EFA (#65576); nightly EFA images as `vllm/vllm-openai:efa-nightly` (#64028).
**Build**: One ROCm build and release pipeline, ROCm 10.0 only (#61939).
**Build**: Source builds fetch `triton_kernels` from a tarball (#65162) and ship tuned kernel configs in the wheel (#64063).
**Build**: CUDA `x.yf` arches no longer fall back to a lower minor (#66016).

items.category: All breaking changes, deprecations and new defaults
items.text: **Model Runner V1 removed** (#63373).

items.category: All breaking changes, deprecations and new defaults
items.text: `VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER` and `VllmConfig.use_v2_model_runner` are gone; setting the env var to anything but `1` fails at startup.

items.category: All breaking changes, deprecations and new defaults
items.text: Dropped with it: the V1 logits-processor API (`vllm.v1.worker.gpu.sample.logits_processor` is the only interface), the `custom_class` speculative method, `use_heterogeneous_vocab`, `disable_padded_drafter_batch`, `parallel_drafting` outside DFlash/DSpark, PP with `external_launcher`, `NGramPerReqLogitsProcessor`, and x86 CPUs without Triton.

items.category: All breaking changes, deprecations and new defaults
items.text: Deprecated: `parallel_drafting`, `capture_torch_profiler`, `enable_layerwise_nvtx_tracing`.

items.category: All breaking changes, deprecations and new defaults
items.text: **Default `--block-size` is 64** instead of 16 (#63231). Backends with a preferred block size still override it (ROCm paged attention keeps 16), and an explicit `--block-size` still wins.

items.category: All breaking changes, deprecations and new defaults
items.text: **`gpu_memory_utilization` defaults to 1.0** when unset with the extensible KV cache on (#56492). An explicit value in (0.8, 1.0) that withholds 1 GiB or more logs a warning (#66704).

items.category: All breaking changes, deprecations and new defaults
items.text: **ROCm 7.2** wheels and `-rocm72` images are no longer published (#61939).

items.category: All breaking changes, deprecations and new defaults
items.text: **Removed:**: QuTLASS and the `fp_quant` method (#65230).

items.category: All breaking changes, deprecations and new defaults
items.text: **Removed:**: Marlin INT8/FP8-activation (W4A8) paths and `VLLM_MARLIN_INPUT_DTYPE`; use `--quantization humming` with `VLLM_HUMMING_INPUT_QUANT_CONFIG` (#65542).

items.category: All breaking changes, deprecations and new defaults
items.text: **Removed:**: Keye-VL and Keye-VL-1.5 (#64287); `disable_mtp_completeness_check` (#49459); the `refresh_derived_weights` hook (#65914).

items.category: All breaking changes, deprecations and new defaults
items.text: **Removed:**: **Dependencies:** `huggingface_hub >= 2.0.0` (#64779); `mistral-common >= 1.13.0` (#64169); XPU requires vllm_xpu_kernels 0.1.17 (#60609).

items.category: All breaking changes, deprecations and new defaults
items.text: **Removed:**: **Model and plugin code:** all `process_weights_after_loading` hooks share one signature and the loader runs every module's hook (#57678); config `compute_hash()` replaced by `compile_factors()` / `hash_config()` (#65652).

items.category: All breaking changes, deprecations and new defaults
items.text: **API behavior:**: llama3_json no longer streams tool arguments incrementally (#63569).

items.category: All breaking changes, deprecations and new defaults
items.text: **API behavior:**: Canary transcription without `language` returns 400 (#65445).

items.category: All breaking changes, deprecations and new defaults
items.text: **API behavior:**: An empty `tools` array is accepted in both frontends (#65547, #65854).

items.category: All breaking changes, deprecations and new defaults
items.text: **API behavior:**: `/v1/systemone` rejects request-supplied chat templates without `--trust-request-chat-template` (#64503).

items.category: All breaking changes, deprecations and new defaults
items.text: **API behavior:**: LoRA adapters on modules vLLM does not wrap are refused (#63489); misconfigured NCCL weight transfer raises (#57022).

items.category: All breaking changes, deprecations and new defaults
items.text: **API behavior:**: `vllm-rs serve` no longer reads `--data-parallel-rank` from `VLLM_DP_RANK` (#65369).

items.category: All breaking changes, deprecations and new defaults
items.text: **API behavior:**: AITER fused shared experts with MiniMax M3 and DeepSeek V4 need `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1` (#61457).

items.category: All breaking changes, deprecations and new defaults
items.text: **API behavior:**: **Still deprecated:** `--mamba-cache-mode` has no effect; its removal was postponed (#64838).

items.category: All breaking changes, deprecations and new defaults

items.text: **New defaults:**: TRITON_ATTN on RDNA3/RDNA4 (#60418); MRV2 on non-Triton CPUs (#61995); `float32` Mamba SSM cache for Nemotron Omni (#63218); Zipf routing in `vllm bench forward` (#64167).
Model Runner V1 removed — Action: Remove `VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=0`; it now fails at startup. Port V1 logits processors to `vllm.v1.worker.gpu.sample.logits_processor`. (#63373)
Default `--block-size` is 64 (was 16) — Action: Pass `--block-size 16` to keep the old behavior. ROCm paged attention still uses 16. (#63231)

Extensible KV cache on by default; `gpu_memory_utilization` defaults to 1.0 — Action: **In most cases it's now best to not set `gpu_memory_utilization`**. This should provide maximum kv cache capacity while avoiding runtime OOMs. Use it to share a GPU with other processes or when extensible kv cache is disabled. (#56492)
ROCm 7.2 artifacts dropped — Action: Use the ROCm 10.0 wheels and images. `-rocm72` is no longer published. (#61939)
`huggingface_hub >= 2.0.0` required — Action: Also requires `tokenizers >= 0.23.3` and `timm >= 1.0.30`. (#64779)
QuTLASS / `fp_quant` removed — Action: `fp_quant` checkpoints no longer load. (#65230)
Marlin W4A8 removed — Action: Use `--quantization humming` with `VLLM_HUMMING_INPUT_QUANT_CONFIG` instead of `VLLM_MARLIN_INPUT_DTYPE`. (#65542)
Keye-VL and Keye-VL-1.5 removed — Action: — (#64287)

Baidu Unlimited-OCR-2: DASH sparse attention (#64016)
Liquid AI LFM3, LFM3-VL, LFM3-Audio:  (#65826, #65827, #65828)
NVIDIA Canary-1B-v2: ASR and X↔En translation (#64215)

items.category: Extensible KV cache, on by default
items.text: On CUDA and ROCm, the KV cache is sized from memory actually free **after** CUDA graph capture and warmup, not from an estimate (#56492).

items.category: Extensible KV cache, on by default
items.text: **Result:** a larger cache (e.g. MiniMax-M3 on H200: 433k → 672k tokens), so throughput is higher and TTFT lower at high concurrency.

items.category: Extensible KV cache, on by default
items.text: **Trade-off:** per-token decode latency can rise on some models (TPOT +6–18% on some H200 models at concurrency 128). Opt out with `--gpu-memory-utilization 0.9` or `--no-enable-extensible-kv-cache`.

items.category: Extensible KV cache, on by default
items.text: Hardened with fixes for allocator fragmentation, startup OOMs and KV connectors (#67296, #67485, #66731, #66523, #66197, #65137, #66605, #66674).
Model Runner V1 is removed (#63373).
Dual-batch overlap now runs on MRV2, including with speculative decoding and DCP (#61464).
**Suffix decoding** runs on MRV2 with a GPU speculator; Arctic Inference is no longer needed (#60339).
**Custom speculators:** declarative configs plus a `register_speculative_method` plugin API (#63205).
**CUDA graphs** for MRV2 draft-model speculators (#60989).
**Adaptive verification** works with XPress (#65175).
**Draft KV cache matches the target's dtype**, so an FP8 target gets an FP8 draft cache (#65198).
Step5 NVFP4 MoE on TRTLLM-Gen on 4×GB200: up to **1.95×** decode (#65152)
GLM-5.3-Flash DeepGEMM FP8 MegaMoE on NVIDIA: **1.6×** output throughput vs DEP4 (#60895)
Muse Spark Open specialized decode (opt-in) on GB300: **1.5×** single-stream decode (#64077)
Token-sharded sparse-MLA prefill under TP (default) on GB200: GLM-5.3 TTFT **1.24–1.40×** faster at 32K–128K (#63956)
KV-balanced MLA decode for Kimi-K3 (opt-in) on GB300: **1.34–1.59×** decode attention (#63638)
Qwen3.5 on breakable CUDA graphs (no torch.compile) on NVIDIA: **3.0–8.8%** lower decode ITL (#51012)
FlyDSL decode monokernel, Muse Spark Open DSpark on 8×MI355X: **+35–57%** interactivity at conc. 1–8 (#63440)
Release images and wheels are **ROCm 10.0 only** (#61939).
MoRI EPv2 via `--all2all-backend mori` (#61361).
Kimi-K3 specialized decode on MI355X, opt-in (#61435).
TRITON_ATTN is the default attention backend on RDNA3 and RDNA4 (#60418).
**Checkpoint/restore** (CRIU + `cuda-checkpoint`) through `/checkpoint/prepare`, `/checkpoint/status` and `/checkpoint/restore`, in both the Python and Rust frontends (#62570).
**Fault-tolerant DP+EP scale-down:** dead ranks are removed and their experts redistributed without a restart (#46370).
Best-effort **NUMA binding** on by default (#61258).
Opt-in **cache-aware admission** ordering (#54625).
Rust frontend: stateless **Responses API** (#63902) and **`n > 1`** (#65625).

upgrade_notices.change: **Model Runner V1 removed** (#63373).
`VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER` and `VllmConfig.use_v2_model_runner` are gone; setting the env var to anything but `1` fails at startup.

Dropped with it: the V1 logits-processor API (`vllm.v1.worker.gpu.sample.logits_processor` is the only interface), the `custom_class` speculative method, `use_heterogeneous_vocab`, `disable_padded_drafter_batch`, `parallel_drafting` outside DFlash/DSpark, PP with `external_launcher`, `NGramPerReqLogitsProcessor`, and x86 CPUs without Triton.
Deprecated: `parallel_drafting`, `capture_torch_profiler`, `enable_layerwise_nvtx_tracing`.
**Default `--block-size` is 64** instead of 16 (#63231). Backends with a preferred block size still override it (ROCm paged attention keeps 16), and an explicit `--block-size` still wins.
**`gpu_memory_utilization` defaults to 1.0** when unset with the extensible KV cache on (#56492). An explicit value in (0.8, 1.0) that withholds 1 GiB or more logs a warning (#66704).
**ROCm 7.2** wheels and `-rocm72` images are no longer published (#61939).
**Removed:**: QuTLASS and the `fp_quant` method (#65230).
**Removed:**: Marlin INT8/FP8-activation (W4A8) paths and `VLLM_MARLIN_INPUT_DTYPE`; use `--quantization humming` with `VLLM_HUMMING_INPUT_QUANT_CONFIG` (#65542).
**Removed:**: Keye-VL and Keye-VL-1.5 (#64287); `disable_mtp_completeness_check` (#49459); the `refresh_derived_weights` hook (#65914).
**Removed:**: **Dependencies:** `huggingface_hub >= 2.0.0` (#64779); `mistral-common >= 1.13.0` (#64169); XPU requires vllm_xpu_kernels 0.1.17 (#60609).

**Removed:**: **Model and plugin code:** all `process_weights_after_loading` hooks share one signature and the loader runs every module's hook (#57678); config `compute_hash()` replaced by `compile_factors()` / `hash_config()` (#65652).
**API behavior:**: llama3_json no longer streams tool arguments incrementally (#63569).
**API behavior:**: Canary transcription without `language` returns 400 (#65445).
**API behavior:**: An empty `tools` array is accepted in both frontends (#65547, #65854).
**API behavior:**: `/v1/systemone` rejects request-supplied chat templates without `--trust-request-chat-template` (#64503).
**API behavior:**: LoRA adapters on modules vLLM does not wrap are refused (#63489); misconfigured NCCL weight transfer raises (#57022).
**API behavior:**: `vllm-rs serve` no longer reads `--data-parallel-rank` from `VLLM_DP_RANK` (#65369).
**API behavior:**: AITER fused shared experts with MiniMax M3 and DeepSeek V4 need `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1` (#61457).
**API behavior:**: **Still deprecated:** `--mamba-cache-mode` has no effect; its removal was postponed (#64838).
**New defaults:**: Extensible KV cache (#56492); block size 64 (#63231); best-effort NUMA binding (#61258).
**New defaults:**: Token-sharded sparse-MLA prefill at 1024 or more prefill tokens (#63956); MLA decode up-projection before the A2A merge (#64994).
**New defaults:**: `VLLM_COMPILE_ON_ONE_RANK` (#63247); minimum valid EPLB `num_redundant_experts` (#30614).
**New defaults:**: HiSparse on the extensible KV cache (#65214); encoder CUDA graphs up to `encoder_cudagraph_max_token_budget=5120`, eager above (#65227).
**New defaults:**: TRITON_ATTN on RDNA3/RDNA4 (#60418); MRV2 on non-Triton CPUs (#61995); `float32` Mamba SSM cache for Nemotron Omni (#63218); Zipf routing in `vllm bench forward` (#64167).
Model Runner V1 removed

benchmarks.claim: **DeepSeek-V4 / V4.1**: `fused_inv_rope_fp8_quant` 3.5× faster, prefill 6% faster (#63540).
**DeepSeek-V4 / V4.1**: Packed multi-image vision encoding, 1.6–2.6× (#65030).
**Muse Spark**: One RoPE cache shared across layers: 11.5 GiB per GPU saved, 14.5% more KV cache on 8×B200 (#65206).
**MiniMax-M3 / M3.1**: Sequence parallelism and GEMM-RS for TP + MegaMoE, 14–20% lower P50 TTFT (#64659), also with PP (#65537).
**MiniMax-M3 / M3.1**: Fused norm + MXFP8 quant, 1.39–1.60× (#64852).
**Qwen**: GDN prefill state gather/scatter fused for Qwen3-Next/Qwen3.5 and Kimi KDA, 1.16–1.50× (#66064).
**Other models**: Moved to the Transformers modeling backend: OLMoE (#63384), Gemma v1 and StableLM (#66393), Aria (#59767; temporarily about 11% less KV cache and 25% lower image throughput).
**Extensible KV cache**: Headroom for measured allocator fragmentation, validated on Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FP8 at TP8+EP on 8×H200 (#67296).
**Model Runner V2**: Staged writes copied straight into UVA (#63633); idle sampler writes skipped, about 10–11% faster small-batch decode (#62748).
**Speculative decoding**: Trace replay with ngram/EAGLE3/MTP, 1.47–2.03× (#63275); 3× faster resample kernel (#65100).
**Scheduler and engine overhead**: Prompt token ids kept as int32 buffers: 40× less per-request CPU on a 128K prompt (#62702).
**Startup and compile**: `BasevLLMParameter`'s Python `__torch_function__` dropped: GLM-5.2-FP8 TTFT −6.1% on GB300 (#63785).

**KV connectors**: NIXL: push mode via `transfer_mode` (#64230); `ucx_backend_params` (rocm_ipc on MI355X: 3.4 → 483.7 Gbps, #62905); 38% fewer hybrid SSM transfer bytes (#62317); block pairing across different P/D block sizes (#59746), with mismatched push handshakes rejected (#59747); same-host NVLink with the extensible KV cache (#65137).
**HiSparse**: Fused slot invalidation, up to 1.8% lower TPOT on GLM-5.3-NVFP4 (#60103); fewer hash probes (#61263); speculative-group prefetch (#63801).

**NVIDIA**: DeepSeek-V4.1: latency_specialized decode extended, 5.9–17% faster decode step on GB300 (#63921); swap-AB CuTe DSL decode attention for TP2/TP4, 1.4–2.15× (#62633); opt-in fused DSpark Markov sampling, 1.6–3.9× (#64442).
**NVIDIA**: CuTe DSL BF16x3 router GEMM for fp32 routers on Hopper (#61903); fused GDN MTP decode for DSpark K=8, +18% on B300 (#65874).
**NVIDIA**: GLM-5.3-Flash on 2× DGX Spark, 15% lower TPOT (#62956); faster weight loading on integrated GPUs (#58868).
**AMD ROCm**: Kimi-K3 specialized decode (#61435), AITER-tuned prefill GEMMs: mean TTFT 5.35 → 4.05 s (#63730), opt-in FlyDSL FP8 MLA prefill (#59124).

**AMD ROCm**: RDNA: TRITON_ATTN by default (#60418), AITER Triton kernels on RDNA3 (#52970), HIP GDN prefill backend for gfx1151 (#56307), opt-in W4A16 dense prefill cache: TTFT −22 to −26% on Strix Halo (#60710).
DeepSeek-V4.1 MXFP8 linears on cuBLASLt (#64815); 3× faster MXFP4 activation quant (#63101); faster FP8 quant on SM100+ (#61641).
**Behavior**: The first streamed usage reports cached prompt tokens (#65036); plain completion stream frames render about 9× faster (#52875).
